sloka: सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहसा राक्षसीगणः ।नानाप्रहरणो घोरः समेयादन्तकोपमः ।। ५.३०.२२।।।।
transliteration: sītayā ca kṛte śabde sahasā rākṣasīgaṇaḥ ।nānāpraharaṇo ghoraḥ sameyādantakopamaḥ ।। 5.30.22।।।।

translations.english: "If Sita screams, the horde of terrific ogresses will at once gather, armed with dreadful weapons like Yama, the god of death.
